author: blu
body: A third read at an out-of-range LBA is the liveness check on the failure channel: if that does not report failure, then a pass on the other two says nothing, because nothing here can report anything.

author: blu
body: blu's ASDE stage rides here rather than on its own boot, because the body at the bench is the expensive line and these two arms cost no extra flash.

author: blu
body: THEY MUST STAY LAST. This stage is unproven on metal -- that is what the flight is for -- and the four rows above it answer a storage question that cost a board trip to ask. Painted first, those rows survive an ASDE arm that faults or hangs on the real part.
